mouse.title: Mouse
mouse.naturalHint: The content moves against the wheel's direction.
noDevice: No trackpad found on this computer. These settings apply when you connect one.
speedHint: Slow movements are precise; fast ones cross the screen.
tapHint: Tap with one finger to click, two for a secondary click, three for a middle click.
tapDragHint: Tap, then put your finger back down right away to drag.
threeDragHint: Move windows and select text without pressing. Swipes move to four fingers.
dwtHint: Touches that start while you type don't move the pointer.
scrollHint: Moving two fingers together scrolls the view, pixel by pixel.
kineticHint: Release quickly and the view keeps going, then slows down.
pinchHint: Spread or pinch two fingers to zoom in or out (also in Chromium and GTK).
swipe3Hint: Up: the app launcher or start menu. Down: close it. Left and right: switch windows.
swipe4: Four finger swipe for the desktop
swipe4Hint: When off, apps receive the four finger gesture.
